system.description:
Smarts; 6 Fire; Close (5 ft). Legendary weapon, linked to the Survivor's Legendary Weapon ability (p74). Fuel (10): each Strike burns 1 fuel, and it can't be used once empty. Highly Flammable: a Fire hit's save is a CR 2 Luck Check, and failing it gives Burning (2) rather than Burning (1).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.149
